parsed.why: No criminalisation; gender-identity anti-discrimination statute and police sensitisation are documented positives, and no LGBT-specific abuse recorded. No trans-specific hostility, but also no trans acceptance record, no LGR, thin data: mid-band.

Self-ID law, facility access by gender identity, hate-crime aggravation actually applied and convictions obtained, high documented acceptance and tourism infrastructure. Offset slightly by one region repealing protections and documented gang violence.

Decriminalised but no anti-discrimination or trans framework at all, documented stigma and low acceptance, 2018 NGO reports of some violence, no recourse; dated and thin data resolve below neutral, with no documented protection.

Sodomy law enforced sporadically plus documented police rape/beating of trans people with impunity — state-tolerated targeting. No trans recognition, no facilities or custody protection, only an informal village sanctuary.

Administrative LGR, gender-identity anti-discrimination law, bias-motive penalties, openly gay head of government, small tolerant unitary state. Deductions for absent hate-crime registration and unresolved care/harassment protocols.
